The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Verig]] was home to a group of primitive '''native''' nomadic [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]]. They used a [[Bola/Legends|bola]]-like weapon, a long rope with stones tied to each end, to trip the large, [[Elephant/Legends|elephantine]] [[Pryss-creature]]s. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] tactician [[Beryl Chiffonage]], inspired by the Verig nomads' primitive, yet effective, hunting strategy, designed a similar tactic for use by [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].

Chiffonage's tactic later resulted in the downing of several AT-ATs during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The Rebellion owed its success during the [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] battle to the nomads of Verig.
